nusmp.armour.dry: Your mana gives out. The %s falls away.
nusmp.armour.lost: The %s answers to nothing and falls away.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_armour: Flame Armour - Fuegoleon's armour of the Crimson Lion. Cast it and the armour forges on; it stays until you cast the page again (taking it off is free), your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on fire cannot hurt you, a tenth of every blow is turned aside, you hit harder, and every blow sets its target alight with four extra damage. The cast itself also gives thirty seconds of Fire Resistance and Strength. A little mana is paid every second. No other spell ever puts it on.
nusmp.page.book_water.valkyrie_dress: Valkyrie Dress - Noelle's water becomes armour. Cast it and the Valkyrie armour forges on; it stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on you are faster, harder to hurt and hit harder. The cast also gives thirty seconds of Speed, Strength, Resistance and Jump. A little mana is paid every second. No other spell puts it on; Spirit Dive is Undine's own form.
nusmp.page.book_water.scale_mail: Sea Dragon's Scale Mail - scales of water close over you: absorption hearts and resistance for fifteen seconds, allies near you are healed, and the water armour forges on. It stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; a little mana is paid every second.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.thunder_fiend: Thunder Fiend - lightning wreathes your body. The lightning armour forges on and stays until you cast the page again (or Black Lightning Battle Fiend, or Raging Lightning), your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on lightning cannot hurt you and you are faster and hit harder; the cast gives thirty seconds of very high speed and every blow arcs to a second foe. A little mana is paid every second. (Luck Voltia's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_lightning.black_lightnin: Black Lightning Battle Fiend - black lightning: the black armour forges on (it stays like Thunder Fiend's), the cast gives thirty seconds of higher speed and strength, and every blow arcs to two more foes. (Luck Voltia's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_lightning.raging_lightni: Raging Lightning - the lightning armour forges on and stays until you cast a Fiend page or this page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. The cast gives thirty seconds of Speed III and Strength II, and every two seconds a bolt strikes the nearest foe within eight blocks.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloak: Dark Cloaked Guard - Yami's Dark Cloaked. The dark armour forges on and stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. While it is on a tenth of every blow is turned aside and you hit harder. The cast gives fifteen seconds of resistance and absorption, and twelve percent of the damage you deal comes back as healing. The Dark Cloaked slashes are spells: they never put the armour on.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_shield: Silver Guardian - the mercury coats your whole body. The silver armour forges on and stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; a fifth of every blow is turned aside, and the poison costs you half a hit point a second, never below six. The cast also raises a dome for eight seconds: shots sink into it, blows land at half strength (fire melts through); when it ends the dome flows back into spears and hurls them at everything near.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.gem_plate_armou: Gem Plate Armour - the corundum armour of Ideal Closer. Faceted red and blue plates grow over your shoulders, chest, forearms and shins, and gem shards circle you for twenty seconds (Resistance III, Strength; every shard darts at the nearest hostile within 12 blocks for 3.5 damage and Slowness II). The armour itself stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; a well-mastered grimoire (or a devil state) also grows a crystal crown and wings of shards.
nusmp.page.book_beast.primal_beast_form: The beast inside breaks the surface. For 30 s you gain Strength II, Speed II and your melee hits deal 4.5 extra damage (scaled by EP); the beast armour of fur, ears, a flaming tail and claws forges on and stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die. Cast while sneaking it becomes the great-beast shape: a ghost beast head and shoulders hover over you, the bonus is 6 and you gain Resistance I. No other spell puts it on.
nusmp.page.book_earth.earth_armor: The Gnome Plate: packed soil with grass and roots forges over your body piece by piece, with Resistance and thorns for ten seconds and a share of your aura spent. The plate stays until you cast the page again, your mana runs out, you are knocked out or you die; it shatters out when it ends. Spirit Dive is the spirit's own form.
